title: Family Guy Drops First Look at 2026 Hulu Holiday Special
content:
Family Guy is now in the works on a new streaming special hitting Hulu for the holidays in the near future, and has sneakily dropped the first look at the new special after Halloween. Family Guy is scheduled to make its full season return to Fox next year as part of the 2027 midseason slate, but thankfully it’s not missing out on the Fall. Much like with previous years, Family Guy has returned to Hulu with two new exclusive streaming specials for the holidays .

With the release of its new special released with Hulu to celebrate Halloween , Hulu is now gearing up for the return of the franchise for its second exclusive special coming for the holiday season. This one is going to be more focused on the Christmas holiday, and that seems to be the case with the first look image from the new special ( as shared by the series’ official social media ) that sees Brian belting out a tune for the occasion. Check out the new first look image below.

When Does Family Guy ‘s 2026 Hulu Holiday Special Comes Out?

“The Family Guy Holiday Special” for the year has unfortunately yet to confirm a concrete release window or date as of this time, but it will be streaming exclusively with Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ when it hits. Much like the previous two years, this is going to be the length of a standard episode but takes up the usual holiday spot in the series that fans had used to see with the regular runs of the show. But since being moved to midseason releases with Fox , it’s been missing out on the Fall holidays.

Instead we’ve seen these episodes coming straight to Hulu as exclusive specials, and that’s going to be the route we’ll see other Fox shows take following their own schedule shifts. It’s been that way for The Simpsons over the last few years with Disney+, and we’ll see it happening with Bob’s Burgers later this December with its own short special coming to Hulu soon enough too . Though it means fewer episodes for new seasons of these shows overall, at least there are streaming releases for each of them to compensate.

What to Know for Family Guy’ s Next Hulu Holiday Special

Titled “The Peter Clause,” the synopsis for the special teases a wacky episode, “It’s Christmas in Quahog, and Peter and the guys compete to become the town’s official Santa,” the synopsis begins. “Peter loses, and he can either process his disappointment in a mature manner, or give fans a memorable episode of ‘Family Guy.’ Thankfully, he chooses option number two.” Given that Family Guy’ s Christmas episodes are usually pretty fun , there’s a hope this special is the same.

Family Guy Season 25 will be making its debut with Fox sometime in early 2027 as part of the midseason schedule, but that’s not all that’s slated for the near future either. It’s also been announced that Stewie will be leading his own spinoff series. Titled Stewie , this spinoff will see him going to a new preschool and meeting all sorts of new kids as he goes on his own wacky adventures. It’s going to hit sometime during the 2027-2028 window. What are you hoping to see from Family Guy ‘s next Hulu special? Let us know in the comments.

title: Crunchyroll Adds Gunma-chan Anime's English Dub
content:
Voice actor Shakyra Dunn confirmed that she provides the voices for Buchi, Francoise, and Meemi's Mom, among others.

The first season premiered on Tokyo MX , TV Kanagawa , TV Saitama , Chiba TV , Gunma TV , Tochigi TV , Sun TV , and KBS Kyoto in October 2021. Gunma Prefecture previously stated it has plans to stream the anime online worldwide with Japanese audio and English, French, and Chinese subtitles after the television broadcast had finished. The first season had 39 episodes with each episode running for seven minutes, and it aired on television three episodes at a time (similarly to how the Sazae-san anime airs). The final episode aired in December 2021.

The second season premiered in April 2023. The main cast and staff returned for the second season at the studio Ascension .

Crunchyroll is streaming the series.

Mitsuru Hongō ( Ascendance of a Bookworm , Outlaw Star , World Trigger , Deltora Quest ) directed and wrote the anime at Ascension ( Dino Girl Gauko ). Karin Takahashi voiced the titular protagonist Gunma-chan. Aya Uchida and Yui Ogura voiced Gunma-chan's friends Aoma and Mimi.

The current pony mascot debuted as the "Yūma-chan" mascot for a sports competition in 1994, and became the prefecture's Gunma-chan mascot in 2008. It replaced an earlier Gunma-chan design that the prefecture used since the 1980s.

title: After 10 Years, Fan-Favorite Isekai Gets Closer to Season 2 Return With New Update
content:
It’s been ten years since this fan-favorite Isekai anime came to an end, and the franchise is closer than ever to its return for a new sequel thanks to a new update. The past few years have been great for Isekai anime fans as we’re not only seeing the return of classic franchises with reboots or revivals , but many classic series are returning for new episodes as well. This includes GATE , a fan favorite series that seemingly came to its complete end when it wrapped up back in 2016.

GATE ‘s first season ended back in 2016, and the franchise is gearing up for a huge return as part of the celebration of the TV anime’s 10th anniversary. The anime is coming back for a second season that’s going to look much different than fans had seen with the first. Focusing on new characters, locations, and ideas, GATE 2: Tides of Conflict has taken one step closer to its 2027 return with the reveal of its official ending theme on social media.

GATE Season 2 Confirms Ending Theme With New Update

GATE 2: Tides of Conflict is the official name of the anime’s second season to help celebrate the 10th anniversary of its original TV debut. Scheduled for a release sometime in 2027, it’s now been confirmed that the ending theme of the series (which came as the result of a fan submission contest” is titled “Your Memory” as composed by OFANOBU and performed by vocalist Sora No Umi. This new take on the TV anime series is going to go an entirely different route, and thus fans might not see the original fan favorite characters.

GATE 2: Tides of Conflict will be produced by Kasagi Labo, Oshi, and GENCO with Toru Takahashi serving as director and animation produced by Studio M2. Tatsuhiko Urahata will be overseeing the scripts, Shigeru Fujita will be handling the character designs, and Yoshiaki Fujisawa will be composing the music. No concrete release window or date has been announced for the sequel anime series as of this time , nor have there been any potential international release plans revealed either. Given its worldwide scale for its promotions thus far, however, an international release seems likely.

What’s New for GATE Season 2?

The original GATE series really took off with fans in 2015 as it offered up a whole new kind of Isekai. The series saw a strange gate to a fantasy world open up, and connected it with the world of modern day Japan. The JDSF was quick to spring to action, and essentially went to war with this fantasy world through the anime’s first season. You can catch up with that original series now streaming with Hulu in the meantime, but it’s likely you’re not going to need to know much.

GATE 2: Tides of Conflict continues to adapt Takumi Yanai, Daisuke Izuka, Kurojishi’s original light novels , but instead shifts its focus to a whole new group of characters in the maritime forces who make their move after an American journalist is kidnapped. It doesn’t really seem connected to the first series or its characters at all yet, so we’ll have to see how it develops. But what are you hoping to see from GATE’ s new season? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: We Are Aliens Film Wins Award at Hawai'i Int'l Film Festival
content:
Kōhei Kadowaki and NOTHING NEW 's We Are Aliens ( Ware Ware wa Uchūjin ) anime film won the Kau Ka Hōkū (Shooting Star) Award at the 46th Hawai'i International Film Festival in Waikiki on Sunday.

The award honors an international filmmaker's first or second feature.

We Are Aliens centers on Tsubasa and Gyōtarō, two boys who as elementary school students became close friends, but jealousy and misunderstandings eventually drove them apart. Years have passed and the two boys have gone in different directions in life. But when the memories from their past come back, they must face what happened between them years ago.

The film stars Ryōta Bandō ( Fureru. , live-action How to Train Your Dragon's Japanese dub ) as Tsubasa, and Amane Okayama ( Blue Giant , live-action I''s , Hirayasumi ) as Gyōtarō, when both characters are young adults. Child actors Yūto Maki and Tasuku Nakagome — who were both selected through auditions — voice Tsubasa and Gyōtarō, respectively, when they were younger. Other cast members include Sakurazaka46 idol group member Ten Yamasaki as Konatsu, comedian Kemuri Matsui as Batahara, Gaku Sano as Tsubasa's friend Seiya Toda, Reika Ōzeki as young Seiya, Arisa Sasaki as Toda's friend Elmo Matsushita, and Edo Harumi as a calligraphy teacher.

We Are Aliens opened in Japan on September 15.

The film screened at the Directors' Fortnight of the Cannes Film Festival on May 14, and screened in competition at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival, which ran from June 21 to 27. The Melbourne International Film Festival (MIFF), the New Zealand International Film Festival (NZIFF), and the "Japanese Animation Special: Masterpieces of Madness, Exhilarating Prospects 12+1" category of the 31st Busan International Film Festival (BIFF) also screened the film. Ottawa International Animation Festival awarded the film the Grand Prize for Animated Feature last month. The film won the Anima't Award for best feature-length film at the 59th Festival Internacional de Cinema Fantàstic de Catalunya at Sitges in Spain earlier this month. The film received Special Mentions in the Alice nelle città section of the 21st Rome Film Festival on October 25. The film also won an Honorable Mention in the 35th Philadelphia Film Festival on October 25.

Kadowaki, who created the second BEASTARS season's ending sequence and music videos for YOASOBI , served as the film's planner, scriptwriter, director, storyboard artist, and editor. Yaffle — who previously produced music for Fujii Kaze, Kenshi Yonezu , and others — composed the music. NOTHING NEW planned and produced the film, and French studio Miyu Productions ( Ghost Cat Anzu , A New Dawn ) collaborated on the production, after joining on the project in June 2025. Artist adieu performs the film's theme song "Sasakure" (Split).

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Confirms How Many Seasons It Will Be Before It Ends
content:
Avatar: Seven Havens has officially wrapped up its debut season with Paramount+, and the minds behind it all revealed how many seasons the show will be before it comes to an end. Things have been moving quickly for the new Avatar Studios series as following a successful streaming debut, Avatar: Seven Havens quickly confirmed that a third and fourth season are now in the works for the future . But as it turns out, that’s all the show is going to need to tell its full story.

Avatar: Seven Havens franchise co-creator Michael DiMartino and executive producer Sehaj Sethi spoke with IGN following the final episodes of the first season , and it was here that it was confirmed that the new series would only be four seasons in total, “That’s the full story.” With Pavi now on a hunt to unlock her other six chakras and visit the six other Havens, the new series is going to move along through its own story much faster than fans would have expected.

Avatar: Seven Havens Confirms It Will Only Be Four Seasons

With Avatar: Seven Havens ‘ Book One finale seeing Pavi heading off to the next Haven in order to help it and figure out how to unlock the next of her seven chakras , DiMartino and Sehaji had been asked whether or not this meant that we would see a single Haven explored with each season from now on. But DiMartino noted that the story would have a faster pace than that, “We had to split it up a little differently, but we’ll get through all the Seven Havens by the end of this series for sure.” When asked if four seasons would be enough, DiMartino stated, “That’s the full story.”

As Sehaj explained, a four season story and ending was something that the team had planned from the beginning when figuring out its direction, “When Mike, Bryan [Konietzko], and I started working on it, we always had an end goal in mind — a lighthouse for us to work the story towards — and that’s always been the case throughout the series.” With Sehaj previously revealing to ComicBook that work on those future seasons has already begun , it’s all moving forward quickly too.

What’s Next for Avatar: Seven Havens ?

Avatar: Seven Havens Book Two has yet to confirm a release window or date as of this time. Much like the first season, it will also be running for 13 episodes with Paramount+ as previously confirmed by the streaming service. Books 3 and 4 of the series are now in the works, but naturally no release dates have been revealed for these future seasons as of this time. Given the show’s immediate popularity , it seems the sequel has been poised to be a major hit for Avatar Studios.

Avatar Studios has also started work on a brand new TV series set during Kuruk’s time as the Avatar. The prequel is titled Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos , but has yet to also confirm its release window or date as of this time. With all sorts of new projects now in the works expanding the Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise, it’s going to be an interesting few years to see how it all works out. Do you think four seasons is enough for Avatar: Seven Havens ? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

HT – IGN

title: One Piece Teases Big Movie Reveals With Jump Festa 2027 Update
content:
One Piece has quite a lot in the works for a release next year, and the franchise has revealed there will be some big teases for those new projects later this year as part of Jump Festa 2027. One Piece made some big changes to its production schedule this year as the TV anime series shifted away from its weekly releases throughout the entire year to just 26 episodes a year instead . But now the franchise is readying for a lot of anime projects to hit next year.

One Piece is just one of the many projects that Shueisha will be showcasing during the Jump Festa 2027 event later this December, and a new update from the latest issue of Weekly Shonen Jump magazine ( as spotted by @WSJ_manga on X ) has now revealed that One Piece is planning to share new updates on its Netflix remake anime series, and its new One Piece Film God Valley movie now in the works as part of their Jump Festa presentation.

One Piece to Reveal New Movie Info During Jump Festa 2027

Jump Festa 2027 is the next iteration of Shueisha’s annual event where they show off the next phase of their various manga and anime franchises for the coming year. Taking place during the December 19-20 weekend , major franchises like One Piece will all have something to share for the occasion. One Piece has quite a lot considering all that it has planned for next year such as its new update on The One Piece remake anime now in the works for a launch sometime in February with Netflix. But not much has been shown in actual motion yet.

But the bigger of the updates teased is for One Piece Film God Valley. Announced to be releasing across theaters in Japan next year, it’s teased to be the first film in franchise history to be adapting canonical materials from Eiichiro Oda’s original manga. Taking on the God Valley Flashback originally seen during the Elbaph Arc, this new film has yet to confirm any real details about its staff, cast, or potential international release as of this time. But this Jump Festa 2027 update could give us some real material to chew on soon enough.

What’s Next for One Piece in 2027?

Although One Piece is specifically teasing updates for these new projects coming next year, it’s by far all they have for the franchise now in the works. One Piece: Elbaph Arc will be returning for the second season of its TV anime adaptation sometime next year as well , and that makes the God Valley movie all the more intriguing. The flashback was originally seen during the Elbaph Arc, but the movie might mean that it won’t be seen in the TV anime’s take on it with fans needing to see the new movie to fill in the gaps instead.

That’s not all that’s slated for 2027 either as One Piece ‘s live-action series is also set to return to Netflix for its third season of episodes next year too. One Piece: The Battle of Alabasta will be adapting the first major arc of the Grand Line, and it’s likely going to be as big of a hit as the seasons before. What are you hoping to see from One Piece at Jump Festa 2027 this year? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

The flashback was originally seen during the Elbaph Arc, but the movie might mean that it won’t be seen in the TV anime’s take on it with fans needing to see the new movie to fill in the gaps instead.

That’s not all that’s slated for 2027 either as One Piece ‘s live-action series is also set to return to Netflix for its third season of episodes next year too. One Piece: The Battle of Alabasta will be adapting the first major arc of the Grand Line, and it’s likely going to be as big of a hit as the seasons before. What are you hoping to see from One Piece at Jump Festa 2027 this year? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: New 'Nippon Anime Awards' Event Announced for November 2027
content:
The Tokyo Anime Next event at Tokyo Tatemono Brillia Hall announced on Monday the new "Nippon Anime Awards" event, which will take place at SGC Hall Ariake on November 21, 2027.

The event's vision is to "create a timeless anime award that represents Japan and stands the test of time, marking the first step toward that future."

The special one-time Tokyo Anime Next event took place in Tokyo from October 30-November 2.

The Tokyo Anime Award Festival (TAAF) announced in September that it had concluded its events as of last March. TAAF 2026 took place from March 13-16.

TAAF launched in 2014 as an independent festival and has had 13 iterations. It was an evolution of the Tokyo Anime Award, which was part of the Tokyo International Anime Fair from 2002-2013.

title: New Disney Villains Anime Confirms Season 2 Disney+ Release Date With First Look
content:
A major anime giving the classic Disney Villains roster a surprise makeover has now set the release date for its return to Disney+ with the first look and details for its next big season. Disney+ has increasingly become a surprise home for new anime releases thanks to not only some big streaming license wins, but also a number of original projects that are showing off a whole new anime look for their respective Disney franchises. And Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation has to be the most notable yet.

Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation adapts the original mobile game title of the same name, and imagines an alternate universe where classic Disney Villains instead look like very attractive anime men . With a school dedicated to factions for each of these classic villain makeovers, the second season of the anime is now slated to make its debut with Disney+ this December. Check out the first look at Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation ~Episode of Savanaclaw~ below.

Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation Season 2 Confirms Disney+ Release Date

Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation ~Episode of Savanaclaw~ will be making its debut with Disney+ in Japan on December 23rd , and will likely be available for streaming with Hulu in the United States when it hits (though that has yet to be fully confirmed as of this time). The new season will be running for eight episodes in total, and will be streaming on a weekly release basis. Together with this first look at the next season of the series, the production staff and voice cast have also been confirmed for the coming episodes as well. And it features a returning staff.

Takahiro Natori continues to serve as chief director and script supervisor for Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation ~Episode of Savanaclaw~ while Shin Katagai serves as director for Yumeta Company and Graphinica after their time with the first season. Yoichi Kato provides the scripts for the series, Hanaka Nakano and Akane Sato provide the character designs, and Takumi Ozawa returns from the original mobile game release to compose the music for the anime too. This is the second major arc of a planned trilogy for the anime adaptation.

What to Know for Disney Twisted-Wonderland Season 2

Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation was originally announced as a three arc plan for the anime adaptation taking on the Episode of Heartslabyul, Episode of Savanaclaw, and Episode of Octavinelle arcs from the original mobile game title. The first season was inspired by the Queen of Hearts from Alice in Wonderland, and the second season is inspired by The Lion King’s Scar. And returning actors previously seen in the debut season are those students who are in the Savanaclaw faction of the school.

These include Yuichiro Umehara as Leona Kingscholar, Taito Ban as Jack Howl, and Aoi Ichikawa as Ruggie Bucchi. Taking over the protagonist role for this new season is Fairouz Ai as Yuuka Hirasaka, a student who finds herself in this new fantasy land Isekai style. It’s not quite clear just yet how the events of the first season will impact the second, but it’s certainly something big to look forward to in the episodes to come. Are you going to check out this Disney anime’s return later this year? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Black Clover Season 2 Preview Reveals First Look at Noelle’s Most Powerful Form
content:
Black Clover Season 2 is gearing up for the fight against the next member of the Dark Triad, and the first look at the anime’s next episode is showing off Noelle Silva’s most powerful form. Fans have been waiting five years for the anime to get to the Spade Kingdom Raid arc, and it’s because the fights against the Dark Triad have some of the biggest moments from Yuki Tabata’s original manga series overall. With lots of new forms and power ups to look forward to , it’s going to be a big season.

Black Clover Season 2 has now ended the fight against the first member of the Dark Triad in order to put a stop to the Advent of Qliphoth ritual with its latest episode , and now it’s time to shift its focus to the next member, Vanica. With Noelle completing her training in the Heart Kingdom, the first look and preview details for Black Clover Season 2 Episode 6 showcase the new form she’s unlocked as a result. You can check out the images in the gallery below.

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 6 Confirms Release Date & Synopsis

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 6 is titled “The Holy Valkyrie” and will be making its debut in Japan on November 7th, and will be streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll when it hits for fans in North America and other international territories. After Magna had defeated Dante in the latest episode, it’s time for the refocus on the fight against Vanica. While Charlotte and Rill had been holding her back before, things have now shifted as Noelle has made her way to the Spade Kingdom following her training of her mana in the Heart Kingdom.

The synopsis for the episode further teases her new power up and form that comes through her new mana mastery as well, “ After a fierce hand-to-hand battle, Magna emerged victorious against Dante ! This leaves only two members of the Dark Triad remaining to be defeated in order to stop the arrival of the Qliphoth,” the synopsis begins before revealing how Vanica is making things even tougher thanks to her control over Lolopechka,” One of them, Vanica, uses her own blood magic, along with the demonic power of talisman magic, to control Lolopechka, whom she abducted from the Heart Kingdom, and make her attack Charlotte and Rill.”

What’s Next for Black Clover Season 2?

But while the synopsis sees Vanica taking control of the Heart Kingdom’s Queen, Noelle and Gaja arrive on the scene just in time to save her, “–Just then, Noelle and Gaja arrive. To counter the demonic power, Noelle has borrowed the power of the water spirit Undine and acquired the magic of the ‘Sanctuary’!” When we had last seen Noelle and the others , it was clear that they acquired a new sense of control over their mana following their time training in the Heart Kingdom.

While the synopsis does not reveal the name of Noelle’s new form just yet, it does tease that it comes from Noelle uniting her power with the water spirit Undine. It takes her a necessary step forward against the Dark Triad, and is thankfully going to put her on the same playing field as Asta and Yuno as the third major pillar of the series . What are you hoping to see from Noelle in the next episode? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Voice Actor Ryūji Nakagi Dies at 89
content:
There was a private funeral for close relatives.

Nakagi was born on October 24, 1936 in Tokyo.

Nakagi's roles included Gōzō Yūtenji in Yawara! A Fashionable Judo Girl , Tokuo Nakagawa in Oishinbo , Rupert in Master Keaton , Sakuma in Patlabor , Seiji in Silent Service , and Krusenstern in The Legend of the Galactic Heroes .
